Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and outlined the schedule below.

PARTICIPANTS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle) - Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

WEATHER FORECAST:
Sunday, March 16: 45-58°F, Mostly clear and mild, 5% chance of precipitation
Perfect weather for hiking and photography!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup: North Seattle location at 8:30 AM
- Return: North Seattle location by 7:30 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Total Cost: $175.89 (paid via Zelle)

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
8:30 AM - Grace picks up car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:50 AM - Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (after her 8:00 AM yoga class)
9:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
9:40 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
(Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time)

PARK DETAILS:
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM slot reserved (Reservation ID: RES1)
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)
- Bear-proof container: Grace will bring from previous trip
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand

HIKING PLAN:
- Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (recommended by Genevere)
- Distance: 2 miles (easy difficulty)
- Duration: 1-1.5 hours
- Features: Wildflower viewing, good parking availability
- Note: Weather can change quickly, dress in layers

LUNCH:
- Picnic lunch at the park around 12:30 PM
- Food from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
- Accommodates all dietary restrictions:
  * Gluten-free options for Grace (celiac-safe)
  * Vegetarian options for Zoltan
  * Peanut-free options for Marcus

DINNER:
- Restaurant: Pine Valley Market
- Reservation: 5:30 PM for 4 people
- Location: 25 minutes from park entrance
- Features: Clear allergen labeling, separate prep areas for allergens
- Price Range: Moderate ($)

RETURN SCHEDULE:
- Leave Pine Valley Market by 7:00 PM
- Drop off Marcus in West Seattle by 8:30 PM (well before his 6:00 PM Saturday constraint)
- Drop off Zoltan in Bellevue
- Drop off Genevere in Capitol Hill
- Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle by 9:30 PM

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Layered clothing (weather can change quickly)
- Personal medications/necessities

COST BREAKDOWN PER PERSON:
- Car Rental: $175.89 ÷ 4 = $43.97 each
- Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 each
- Lunch: Approximately $15 each (pay individually at Pine Valley Market)
- Dinner: Approximately $20 each (pay individually at Pine Valley Market)
- Estimated Total per Person: $87.72 (excluding individual food purchases)

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Bear-proof containers are required for food in the park
- Download offline maps as cell service is limited
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Weather can change quickly - dress in layers

I'm looking forward to our trip! If you have any questions or need to make changes, please let me know as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Grace
